info.title: Afra core API (implementation in progress)
info.description: Current core routes only. See implementation-status.en.md; no exposed-service/delegation API is implemented. Product target contract is separate. Typed planning, dataset, configuration, view, shared-review and quality-report routes are included. Deferred exposed services are excluded; unfinished generic custom fields are not a complete target contract.
